Variants.Content: Mesovium households farm, herd and exchange woodland goods. Requisitioned seed affects the next year; chiefly gifts also depend on limited surplus.

Mesovium farming, herding, woodland and exchange sustain households. Traveling followers need real food from this production; valuables still require a buyer and exchange. Taking seed grain damages the next year’s livelihood.

Taking seed grain damages the next year’s livelihood. Collectors and distributors depend on the next yield too; extra demands leave losses with continuing suppliers. Mesovium farming, herding, woodland and exchange sustain households.
